# Data budget per build (generated by analysis/monitoring/sync/budgets.py)

Assumed: 0.1 mm hatch at 1.0 m/s (100 mm²/s), 30 µm layers, 0.2 s of jumps and an 8 s recoat per layer (heat.md), +10 % of lasing for delays, AE kept for 1 h after the build.

| build | layers | lasing per layer (s) | layer (s) | build (h) | lasing (h) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| B1: S25, 25 % scanned, 5 mm tall | 167 | 1.25 | 9.6 | 0.44 | 0.06 |
| B2: M50, 25 % scanned, 10 mm tall | 333 | 5.01 | 13.7 | 1.27 | 0.46 |
| B3: L75, 70 % scanned, 25 mm tall, with the dwell | 833 | 31.59 | 64.9 | 15.01 | 7.31 |
